title: Actor, Voice Actor Toru Shinagawa Dies at 90
content: Knockout stated Shinagawa had been undergoing medical treatment for lymphoma. Shinagawa was born in Hokkaido in 1935, and graduated from a performing arts institute in 1962. After graduation he joined a theater troupe run by Takeo Hodoshima. Shinagawa was active in stage, film, television, and in voice acting.
author: ANN

title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Announces Hiatus, 4th Stage Play Featuring 'Chimera Ant Arc'
content: This year's 41st issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter X Hunter manga will go on hiatus, and will announce its return at a later date. In addition, a new stage play titled Hunter X Hunter The Stage 4 was announced.
author: ANN

title: Anime India Responds to Artist Alley Vendors' Allegations of Mismanagement at Mumbai 2026 Event
content: Artist TAO claimed to ANN that several vendors had to set up without tables at the event after paying between ₹12,000 to ₹22,000 for a booth including two tables, two chairs, and a power socket. They stated some Artist Alley booths were not provided with tables until 2:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. on August 28.

title: 'Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsutomu 's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. ( Pops Loves Kawaii Stuff ) manga unveiled additional cast, the theme songs, and second promotional video on Monday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.00 p.m.

title: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow Game Posts Gameplay Trailer
content: Arc System Works streamed a gameplay trailer for its upcoming Qliphah in Providence's Shadow game on Friday. The trailer previews gameplay mechanics where players can stack skills within a limited amount of time to deal damage to enemies and counterattack by overlapping skills.

title: Fukakōryoku no I Love You Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Creator's Health
content: Manga creator Mizuki Hoshino announced on Friday that their Fukakōryoku no I Love You (I Love You by Force Majeure) manga will go on hiatus due to their poor health. Hoshino added that they will announce the manga's return at a later date.
author: ANN
